label: Edge-Lit Slab
description: A product screenshot revealed as a thick 3D slab: it begins edge-on as a single glowing, beveled bar of light in a black void, then pivots to face the camera -- the electric rim-light raking across its beveled edges and a specular highlight sweeping the screen -- before a slow macro push-in. Dark, premium, Apple/Framer-style product reveal. Provide screenshot (image URL) and an aspect_ratio matching the image so it fills the slab with no cropping. Best on a pure-black background.

screenshot.label: Screenshot / UI image URL for the slab face

aspect_ratio.label: Card face aspect ratio (W / H) -- match the screenshot to avoid cropping

glow_color.label: Edge glow color (hex). Defaults to the brand primary color.

caption.label: Optional lower caption that fades in late
